item.title: Candidates to Lead the UN Are Falling Into a ‘Reform Trap,’ OSF Official Says
item.description: Candidates seeking to become the next United Nations secretary-general have “fallen into the trap” of allowing debates over staffing cuts and bureaucracy to overshadow the organization’s purpose, according to Pedro Abramovay, Open Society Foundations’ vice president, programs, told PassBlue, ahead of the annual meeting of world leaders at the UN General Assembly. item.title: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right
item.description: Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption.
